title: Model-Based Meta-Analysis (MBMA): Real-World Examples
summary: See real-world examples of how model-based meta-analysis (MBMA) uses existing clinical evidence to predict trial outcomes, strengthen regulatory submissions, and reduce drug development uncertainty.

### See what MBMA could reveal about your drug development program


Model-based meta-analysis can turn existing clinical evidence into actionable insights for trial design, competitive benchmarking, probability of success, and regulatory strategy. Explore how MBMA can help answer critical development questions using the data that already exists.


[Explore the questions MBMA can answer](https://www.certara.com/blog/important-drug-development-questions-that-model-based-meta-analysis-answers/)[Explore MBMA services](https://www.certara.com/services/model-based-meta-analysis/)
